title: Coffee, Cafe Mocha, with non-dairy milk

content.title: About
content.content: Cafe Mocha coffee is an aromatic beverage made from espresso, blended with chocolate syrup and served with a smooth non‑dairy milk (such as oat, almond or soy). It combines the bitterness of coffee, the sweetness of chocolate, and the creaminess of milk for a balanced flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The name “Mocha” comes from the Yemeni port of Mocha, historically a major coffee trading hub.
Traditional chocolate syrup is often made from cocoa mass and sugar, giving the drink its dark color.
Non‑dairy milk alternatives allow lactose‑intolerant and vegan consumers to enjoy mocha without animal products.
Mocha is frequently topped with plant‑based whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa powder.

items.title: Caffeine boost
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, enhancing alertness and reducing fatigue.

items.title: Antioxidants from cocoa
items.content: Chocolate syrup contains flavonoids that may support cardiovascular health.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals from plant milk
items.content: Oat, almond, and soy milks are often fortified with calcium, vitamin D, and B‑vitamins.

items.title: Controlled sugar content
items.content: Choosing unsweetened plant milk and moderating syrup allows better sugar management.

items.title: Digestive support
items.content: Coffee stimulates gastric secretions, and some plant milks provide dietary fiber.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat after caffeine.

items.title: Allergy to plant ingredients
items.content: Almond, soy, or oat milks can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive people.

items.title: Sugar in chocolate syrup
items.content: Traditional chocolate syrup adds sugar, increasing the drink’s calorie count.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: Caffeine can amplify the effects of certain stimulants and reduce the efficacy of some sedatives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve Cafe Mocha hot or iced, adding non‑dairy milk to taste. Top with plant‑based whipped cream, cocoa powder, or a sprinkle of cinnamon. For a vegan version, use sugar‑free chocolate syrup.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep dry ingredients (coffee, chocolate syrup) in a sealed container in a cool, dry, dark place. Opened non‑dairy milk should be refrigerated and used within 5‑7 days.
